subject: Peregrine demo: staggered hosts + recording ownership

Subject: Peregrine demo: staggered hosts + recording ownership

Hi Soojin / Ben —

Thanks again for agreeing to run the joint marketplace demo next week. A couple of operational asks from our side before we lock the calendar:

1) We have two internal streams at Peregrine (product execs in London, and a technical SI team in Munich). Can we split the session into a 35/25 minute staggered host format so both groups get their deep-dive? Redwood team would lead the first 35 (overview + live Q&A) and Peregrine would take the last 25 to showcase integrations.

2) We need a single recording owner for compliance (our security team requires recording retention under the Peregrine account). Can Redwood change the recorder owner to ops@peregrinelabs.com post-call or point to a shared Drive folder?

3) Attached are the high-level requirements and our preferred agenda. Can you confirm availability for 2028-07-29, 14:00–15:00 CET (we propose the split at 14:35 CET)?

If that slot is tight, we can move to 2028-07-30 morning CET.

Appreciate a quick confirm so we can send invites to the two teams.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Partnerships Manager, Peregrine Labs

+44 20 7946 0991

- Peregrine leads 14:35–15:00 CET: SI integration walkthrough + Q&A

Recording ownership: we prefer to host the recording and then transfer a copy to ops@peregrinelabs.com to satisfy your retention controls. I will follow up with Ops to confirm the transfer process and folder destination (Drive link or S3 with ACLs).

B) Move the call 30 minutes later (14:30–15:30 CET) so Ben can do the opening.
